product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Reclaimed Fir Wood Side End Table, 16.5"W, Natural
product.description: At first glance, one might think this side table was carved from a tree stump, and that's not far from the truth: It's made of 95% reclaimed fir wood. Swooping angled sides make it even more eye-catching at the end of a sofa or beside a bed. 16.54"W x 16.54"D x 23.62"H Reclaimed fir wood Rustic wood combines with modern geometric shaping for a transitional look A style statement piece that's a handy side table for a living space or bedroom No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
